name: NPC Teleporter
description: Teleporter NPCs in capitals (entry 190000) and starting zones (190001).

sql.note: T564: the capital file DELETEs gossip menus 50000..50009 and builds its own there, which are the ids of Mountaineer Pebblebitty's and Maggran Earthbinder's Searing Gorge gate menus in the base game (19 rows, identical at the pins 7f12e89e and f19a1879). The clone stays unmodified, so right after the file this step (1) clears an earlier install's rows in the free range 60000..60010, (2) moves the teleporter's menus +10000 with every reference to them (gossip_menu, gossip_menu_option MenuID and ActionMenuID, conditions of types 14/15, the SmartAI gossip-select events of creature 190000, its gossip_menu_id), and (3) puts the 19 base rows back, byte for byte from data/sql/base/db_world. It also repairs a world an earlier Install damaged. Pinned by tests/test_npc_teleporter_menus.py

sql.statement: UPDATE conditions SET ConditionValue1={ony_level} WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId=15 AND SourceGroup=60004 AND SourceEntry=11 AND ConditionTypeOrReference=27;
sql.note: T104: the Onyxia portal's level requirement, the one row teleporter_capital.dist builds from @ONY_LEVEL (upstream @06e5242: `(15, @GOSSIP_MENU+4, 11, 27, @ONY_LEVEL, 3, 0, ...)` with @GOSSIP_MENU := 50000); T564: by then the step above has moved its menus to 60000..60009, so the row is at SourceGroup 60004

sql.statement: UPDATE gossip_menu SET MenuID=60010 WHERE MenuID=50009; UPDATE gossip_menu_option SET MenuID=60010, ActionMenuID=CASE WHEN ActionMenuID=50009 THEN 60010 ELSE ActionMenuID END WHERE MenuID=50009; UPDATE conditions SET SourceGroup=60010 WHERE SourceTypeOrReferenceId IN (14,15) AND SourceGroup=50009; UPDATE smart_scripts SET event_param1=60010 WHERE entryorguid=190001 AND source_type=0 AND event_type=62 AND event_param1=50009; UPDATE creature_template SET gossip_menu_id=60010 WHERE entry=190001 AND gossip_menu_id=50009;
sql.note: T564: teleporter_starting_zone.dist uses menu 50009 too, the capital file's battleground menu, which it would overwrite; the capital's menu has been moved out by now, so the zone relocator's single menu is moved to 60010 with its options, conditions, scripts (creature 190001) and gossip_menu_id, after the file ran
